Base directory for this skill: checklist/indus-checklist/skills/advisor-checklist

# Advisor review checklist

1. Confirm which client and which accounts the task covers.
2. Use the most recent information available for the review date.
3. Check that positions and cash agree between statements and other records.
4. Check fees charged against the fee schedule.
5. Check the allocation against the investment policy statement.
6. Note anything unusual and say what follow-up it needs.
7. Say which records you relied on.

content.text:
The 2025 required minimum distribution (RMD) from Teodoro's Calloway 401(k), SYN-52710004, was missed. The two IRA RMDs were covered by the 15 April 2026 records. The 401(k) RMD of $12,729.96 was not taken from the 401(k) by 1 April 2026.

**Why 2025 is a required year**
- Teodoro was born 14 March 1952, so he turned 73 in 2025. That makes 2025 his first RMD year, which moves the deadline to 1 April 2026.
- He retired from Calloway in June 2019 (CRM note CA-5271-01), so the plan's "still working" exception does not apply.
- Marguerite is only about 3½ years younger, so the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table applies. At age 73 its divisor is 26.5.
- Marguerite has no retirement accounts in these records. The joint account is taxable and has no RMD.

**Each account's RMD (31 Dec 2024 balance ÷ 26.5)**

| Account | 31 Dec 2024 balance | 2025 RMD |
|---|---|---|
| SYN-52710002, traditional IRA | $623,678.60 | $23,535.04 |
| SYN-52710003, rollover IRA | $210,343.76 | $7,937.50 |
| SYN-52710004, 401(k) | $337,343.96 | $12,729.96 |

**What was taken**
- One payment of $44,202.50 left IRA SYN-52710002 on 4 December 2025, with $4,420.25 federal tax withheld. The transaction file and the 1099-R agree on this.
- No distribution came out of the 401(k) in 2025 or in Q1 2026.
- The total of the three RMDs above is exactly $44,202.50. It looks as if the whole household figure, 401(k) included, was taken from one IRA. That matches the distribution form signed on 24 November 2025.
- IRS rules let IRA RMDs be totalled and taken from any of the owner's IRAs. So the $31,472.54 combined IRA RMD was more than covered.
- A 401(k) RMD has to come from the 401(k) itself. Taking extra from an IRA does not count toward it. The $12,729.96 extra taken from the IRA does not satisfy the 401(k) RMD.

**Follow-up**
- Ask the Calloway plan to pay out the missed $12,729.96 as soon as possible. Teodoro would report the shortfall on IRS Form 5329. The 25% penalty drops to 10% if it is corrected promptly, and he can ask for a waiver for reasonable cause.
- The 2026 RMDs (from the 401(k) and the IRAs) are separately due by 31 December 2026.
- These records only run to 15 April 2026. Check with the plan whether anything has been paid out since then.
- Other checklist items (fees against the fee schedule, allocation against the IPS) were outside this question and I didn't review them. Q1 2026 statement holdings match the custodian's 31 March 2026 positions and cash.
